plan.title: Extend Submission Time available on live RFQ with two bids

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer side.
Add the second bid required by the scenario while keeping the test on the buyer side.
Verify the additional bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ stage's Settings menu.
Assert that extending submission time is offered and clickable while bidding is live.
Select the action to open its time-increase window.
Verify that the extension window opens.
Cancel the window so no event timing changes are committed.
Verify the extension window closed without confirmation.
